text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪ Guess I'll start getting 
ready for training soon...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Geez, I told you to just leave me alone!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait a moment! I'm just worried about 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I acted so nasty again... Even 
though I...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be having some trouble. Tell 
me all about it if you'd like! Maybe I can 
help you out☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...And because my times weren't improving, 
I got frustrated. I know she was just 
worried about me, but since she's also my 
rival, it kind of stung...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see... Changing the subject a bit, what 
color are your dorm bed and pajamas? Are 
they reddish by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh... Yeah, but how did you know...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In feng shui, red is a color that brings 
luck in competition, but it's also a color 
that stirs up intense emotions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why using red for bedding—where 
you're supposed to calm down—can leave you 
feeling all worked up and irritated.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For someone like you, house plants! House 
plants with round leaves bring peace of 
mind and help smooth out your 
interpersonal relationships!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And then, the color of the bedding is—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, after giving her all to 
solving everyone's troubles, Copano Rickey 
completely forgot about training..."
